represents: Normalized judge-share point used as a transparent proxy baseline.
information_not_used: Does not use synthetic truth or rule constraints.
evaluation_metric: Absolute synthetic point error and false-certainty diagnostic.
permitted_conclusion: A point proxy can be inaccurate even when it appears decisive.

represents: All strict public rankings remain feasible before observed outcome rules are imposed.
information_not_used: Does not use observed elimination, judge ranks, or synthetic truth.
evaluation_metric: Known-truth coverage and normalized feasible-rank width.
permitted_conclusion: Rule-agnostic ordinal uncertainty is a breadth baseline, not a realistic institutional mechanism.

represents: Historical predictive model treated as a secondary validation comparator.
information_used: Pre-outcome historical covariates under the declared split.
information_not_used: Does not observe synthetic truth and does not encode feasible-set constraints.
permitted_conclusion: Predictive fit is not hidden-preference recovery or identification.

represents: Simplex-only cardinal feasible set without observed-elimination inequalities.
information_not_used: Does not use rule-aware outcome constraints or synthetic truth.
permitted_conclusion: It provides a nested information baseline for the rule-aware polytope.

represents: Synthetic upper-information reference that fixes the simulated public preference.
information_not_used: Unavailable in empirical analysis and not a deployable baseline.
permitted_conclusion: It marks an information bound, not an attainable empirical result.
